content.abstract:
Fourteenth Indian Expedition to Antarctica, Scientific Report, 1998 
Department of Ocean Development, Technical Publication No. 12, pp. 361 
Logistic Activities of 12th Wintering Team
P.M. MEENA
1. All the logistic tasks assigned as per the DOD guidelines have been
completed successfully like, completion of double layer roofing and
flooring of the garage-cum-workshop for vehicle maintenance; Proper
earthing of Maitri complex etc.
In addition, the following works undertaken and completed:
(a) Painting of the station
(b) Renovation of summer camp
(c) Creation of Gen B .C. Joshi recreation hall in summer camp
(d) Improvement of Roads from Maitri to Ice point and Maitri to
Novolazarevskaya station
(e) Painting of 50 KL tank
(f) Backloading of
(i) Forklift (Godrej)
(ii) Crawler Tractor D50 A15
(iii) Snow Cutter
(g) Extensive ecological work in and around Maitri station
(h) Erection of Hindi Signboard of Maitri over the station
2. All kind of assistance was provided to all other departments as and when
asked for/required.
